description: T-1431: LET names outside one-to-one Latin letter pairs: CJK, Turkish dotless i, and a letter number. A use in another case is written _xlpm.<name> so the workbook binds it the way Excel decides, not by spec2xlsx's Python lower(). Excel refuses (createSession 501 FileCorruptTryRepair) a LET naming Turkish dotted İ or the circled letter Ⓐ, in either case spelling, so those forms are not in this case (docs/excel-semantics/references.md).
